# tagging scheme

The tag scheme within which the tagging act is performed. Functional per relator: one scheme per Tagging (the tag itself may belong to multiple schemes).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/taggingScheme>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:taggingScheme`  

**Type:** `owl:FunctionalProperty`, `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/tags>
